Model scores event by event

Source: R/events.R
event_scores.Rd

Scores simulated flow against observed flow within each event's flow window, as found by find_events(): how well a model reproduces the peaks, their timing and the volumes of individual events, which a score over the whole record hides.

Usage

event_scores(events, simulated, observed, dt = attr(events, "dt") %||% 1)

Arguments

events

Events from find_events().

simulated, observed

Simulated and observed flow, aligned with the record the events were found in.

dt

Time step, hours. By default, the step the events were found at.

Value

events with the observed and simulated peaks and these scores added: peak_error (simulated over observed peak, less one), timing_error_h (hours from the observed to the simulated peak within the window; positive when the model is late), volume_error (relative error in flow volume over the window) and nse (over the window). Steps with no observation are left out.

See also

find_events(), batch_events()

Examples

river <- synthetic_catchment(years = 2, dt = 1, seed = 1)
events <- find_events(river$forcing$rain, river$observed, dt = 1)
scores <- event_scores(events, river$true_flow, river$observed)
summary(scores$peak_error)
#>      Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
#> -0.127720 -0.032203  0.001785 -0.001887  0.025619  0.168318
